name: K2 Space
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: K2 Space is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and registered fund that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: K2 Space is a privately held space technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $500 million Series D round announced on July 30, 2026, valued the company at $6.8 billion.

Founded in 2022, K2 Space designs and manufactures large, high-power satellites for commercial and government customers. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Shares reported by ARK Venture Fund (July 31, 2026)
round_notes: Kleiner Perkins and ICONIQ co-led the Series D. In July 2026, K2 Space's chief executive said the company had signed $1 billion of commercial and government contracts; that figure is the company's own.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Kleiner Perkins and ICONIQ co-led the Series D, with participation from CapitalG, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Altimeter, Spark Capital, Sands Capital, ARK Invest and accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates. Redpoint Ventures led the Series C, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Altimeter Capital co-led the Series B, and Altimeter Capital led the Series A. Other investors include Hedosophia, Alpine Space Ventures and First Round Capital.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show one special purpose vehicle formed to invest in K2 Space, organized in 2023.
funds: One SEC-registered fund reports a position in K2 Space. As of July 31, 2026, ARK Venture Fund held 159,904 shares, which it valued at $24.7 million, or $154.41 per share.
sources: Sources: reports by Payload (July 2026 and December 2025), Via Satellite (February 2025) and CNBC (February 2024); ARK Venture Fund's Form N-PORT for July 31, 2026; and SEC Form D filings.
